value.rationale: This is the complete classification of the forced exactly-three-prime stratum of odd almost practical numbers. The support \(\{3,5,7\}\) is not arbitrary: Stewart's criterion forces it. The theorem closes a documented boundary left by the standard \(a\ge3\) sufficient family and isolates one exact exceptional exponent triple.
